recovery.title: Frequently Asked Questions
recovery.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about your Getly account, wallet, virtual cards, and eSIM.

items.q: How do I sign in or recover my Getly account?
items.a: Getly uses your registered email address for account authentication. On the sign-in screen, enter your email and tap 'Forgot password' to receive a secure login link or reset OTP in your inbox. No phone number is required.

items.q: What should I do if I haven't received my email verification code?
items.a: Check your email spam and junk folders for a message from Getly. Ensure your registered email address was entered correctly. If the code hasn't arrived after two minutes, tap 'Request New Code' in the app or contact our team at info@getly.qa.

items.q: How do I change my registered account email?
items.a: If you are signed in, you can update your email under Profile → Security with dual authentication. If you've lost access to your email inbox, reach out to our support team at info@getly.qa so we can verify your identity and restore access.

items.q: How do I freeze or replace my virtual travel card?
items.a: Open the Cards tab in the Getly app and tap 'Freeze Card' immediately to pause all activity. You can unfreeze it at any time with one tap, or remove it and generate a new virtual card in seconds.

items.q: How do I fund my Getly USD wallet?
items.a: You can top up your wallet in seconds using any domestic debit or credit card, bank payment option, or global payment rails. Your local currency is converted at transparent live rates into your USD balance.

items.q: How does the Getly eSIM work when traveling abroad?
items.a: Pick your destination in the eSIM tab and install your digital data profile using the in-app installer or QR code. It connects to high-speed local mobile networks automatically as soon as your flight lands in 180+ countries, with zero roaming fees.
